messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: pod restart storm detected: runtime-serving deployment 'redwood-runtime' in pool gpu-eu-2 >80% restarts in 5m. Pager: @jamie_oncall
jamie_oncall: seeing container CrashLoopBackOff with SIGSEGV. starting triage.
mike_runtime: logs show fused kernel call failing in trt_executor, stack contains: SIGSEGV at 0x7f... maybe nvml or vllm code path.
jamie_oncall: taking lead. eva_platform, can you check node health and nvlink?
eva_platform: checking node n-eu-02: GPU memory reports normal but dmesg shows nvlink reset + IOMMU error. nodename: n-eu-02
mike_runtime: paste log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:05Z] runtime: invoking TRT fused kernel
[2026-03-17T10:12:05Z] segfault (SIGSEGV) at ip 0x7f9c1ab2
#0 0x7f9c1ab2 in trt::execute()
#1 0x7f8b2c4a in vllm::run()
``` 
sre_pager: mitigation options: cordon node, drain runnable pods to gpu-eu-3, scale down replica count to 3, roll runtime to last-known-good image.
jamie_oncall: cordoning n-eu-02 now to stop new pods: `kubectl cordon n-eu-02`
eva_platform: cordon done. starting drain for pods that can reschedule. downtime risk low for nondedicated pools.
carla_cs: customer impact: several EU customers reported increased 5xxs and timeouts since 10:12 UTC. frontline tickets opened, CS notified.
mike_runtime: suggestion: fallback route policy -> route new requests to cpu-quant model for <10% of traffic to avoid user-visible failures. patching rollout config.
jamie_oncall: doing a canary rollout of runtime:v1.4.2-rollback across gpu-eu-3, gpu-eu-4. if stable, promote. will also push a temporary env var to disable fused-kernel flag: ENABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=false
mike_runtime: command to fetch core dumps and symbols:
```
sudo journalctl -u runtime | tail -n 200
kubectl logs -n runtime <pod> --previous
gdb -c core ./runtime -ex 'bt full' -batch
```
jamie_oncall: applied rollout and set ENABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=false on affected daemonset. watching metrics.
eva_platform: node n-eu-02 shows no further SIGSEGV after cordon + reboot, nvlink errors persist until driver reset.
sre_pager: restarted runtime pods on gpu-eu-3 and gpu-eu-4, error rate reduced from 12% -> 0.8% in 7m.
carla_cs: update sent to customers: brief explanation and ETA 'investigating; mitigation applied; follow-up report later'.
mike_runtime: saving stack traces and artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/3068904321/. filing bug to trt-plugin team and vLLM maintainers.
jamie_oncall: handing off to @mike_runtime for detailed debugging for next 4 hours. I'll be available for escalation. pager muted for me.
mike_runtime: taking over. will request kernel/driver team to repro on spare node. assigning follow-ups: #1 reproduce w/ synthetic model, #2 confirm if quantization triggers fail, #3 verify driver/bios.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: 3068904321 acknowledged by jamie_oncall -> transitioned to active. Sev: P2. Tags: segfault, cuda, nvlink, rollback
jamie_oncall: closing live pager. will re-open if regressions >1%.
